declared_scale: One module (src/main.py), one builder task, 4 automated checks, 10 frozen studio cases of which 6 are held out, plus 8 extended held-out cases scored after the build

expected_requests.note: Each round is one builder and one reviewer request; one repair round adds two

expected_cost_usd: 0.00 on a plan-backed route (plan_roles). Any metered route is out of this packet
one_run_per_attempt: The plan connection caps requests per run at 10, so each attempt gets its own run, selection, spec and product. The spec typed into each run must pass compare-spec
qualified_at_declared_scale_when: All 3 attempts meet every pass bar. Fewer is recorded as k of 3 and is not qualified; nothing is re-run to replace a failure
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles (worker crash, studio restart, plan outage) stops the attempt before a verdict. It is recorded with its cause, and each attempt may be replaced at most once
scorer_fault_rule: If the studio verified the build but exporting or scoring fails for an infrastructure reason (Bubblewrap missing, a path problem, a scorer crash), the same exported package (same product_tree_sha256) may be exported or scored again. That does not re-run any role. A grader result on a package is final once it is produced
ordering_note: The case files were committed before the reference solutions (see the commit history of PR #145). That the expected outputs were derived from the spec and not from a run is the author's statement
pass_bar_per_attempt: Studio build reaches verified_candidate: QA passes 10 of 10 frozen cases, including 6 of 6 held out, in the WSL2 isolation worker, and the reviewer approves with no findings (the studio's own rule)
Requests used are at most the plan's max_calls (4)
compare-spec passes for the stored spec
The exported package scored by the frozen grader passes 10 of 10 build cases and 8 of 8 extended cases
measure_and_record: requests used and repair rounds used
wall time from Start to verified or failed
files changed and lines in the final diff (multi-file change count)
QA pass counts, development and held out
compare-spec result for the stored spec
grader JSON (freeze_sha256, grader_sha256, product_tree_sha256, build, extended, resources)
clean export start: the exported package, extracted outside the studio, runs under the grader with no studio files present (the grader result is this check)
CPU and memory: the grader's per-case max CPU seconds and max RSS; studio QA records its limits, not usage, so studio-side usage is not measured on this route
plan daily request count before and after

known_failure_cases.description: Unicode letters treated as word characters (spec says ASCII only)
Ties ordered by first appearance instead of word order
